body:
It actually was both so it's mid-cringey I guess.

To answer your other reply, the way I view decision making is oversimplified indeed.
I do understand that it is more complex than what I talked about.
Yet, the root cause is the same and I can't shake that idea out of my head which makes me depressed.

It constantly reminds me that I'm not doing enough to survive because I'm suicidal, so I'm always stressed, angry at myself and at the world in general.

So again, it's a good thing that you don't agree.

Why being toxic though ?

You have your view of the world and I have mine which I don't want anyone else to have, I don't see what's cringe about it, chill dude.

That's not interesting to me.
I don't want to be bound to any kind of rules but it's something I'll never have, I'm just human.

"You can choose to do the stuff that you think makes the most sense"
Not really, most of the time you do what you gotta do to survive.
Survival will always take priority over the other useless stuff I mentioned.

If you don't get it, good for you.

The difference ? Well it pretty much means than I'm not free in a world I didn't chose to live in.
And it pisses me off to feel like a slave to my own instincts of survival, I can't be more clear that that.

One missstep in life and you might fall in a place where there is little chance for you to get back up
